from pathlib import Path
src = Path('/inputs/report.html')
dst = Path('/work/report.html')
data = src.read_bytes()
needle = b'</head>'
if data.count(needle) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError(f'Expected exactly one existing closing head tag, found {data.count(needle)}')
insertion = (b'    <meta name="description" content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview).">\n'
             b'    <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">\n')
pos = data.index(needle)
out = data[:pos] + insertion + data[pos:]
dst.write_bytes(out)
print(f'wrote {dst}: {len(out)} bytes (inserted {len(insertion)} bytes at offset {pos})')

from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser

src = Path('/inputs/report.html').read_bytes()
out_path = Path('/work/report.html')
out = out_path.read_bytes()
out.decode('utf-8')
needle = b'</head>'
pos = src.index(needle)
insertion = out[pos:pos + (len(out)-len(src))]
assert out[:pos] == src[:pos]
assert out[pos+len(insertion):] == src[pos:]
assert out[pos+len(insertion):].startswith(needle)

class MetaAudit(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.in_head = False
        self.metas = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'head': self.in_head = True
        elif self.in_head and tag == 'meta': self.metas.append(attrs)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'head': self.in_head = False

a = MetaAudit(); a.feed(out.decode('utf-8'))
selected = []
for attrs in a.metas:
    d = dict(attrs)
    if d.get('name') in ('description', 'robots'):
        selected.append((attrs, d))
assert len(selected) == 2, selected
expected = {
    'description': 'AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview).',
    'robots': 'noindex, nofollow',
}
for attrs, d in selected:
    assert len(attrs) == 2 and [k for k, _ in attrs] == ['name', 'content'], attrs
    assert d['content'] == expected[d['name']], d
assert [d['name'] for _, d in selected] == ['description', 'robots']
